import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
import os
import warnings

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

# Load data
print("Loading data...")
train_df = pd.read_csv("./input/ru_train.csv")
test_df = pd.read_csv("./input/ru_test_2.csv")
sample_submission = pd.read_csv("./input/ru_sample_submission_2.csv")

print(f"Train shape: {train_df.shape}")
print(f"Test shape: {test_df.shape}")

# Split training data into train and validation sets
# Stratify by 'class' to maintain distribution, though we won't use 'class' for prediction
train_split, val_split = train_test_split(
    train_df, test_size=0.1, random_state=42, stratify=train_df["class"]
)

print(f"Train split shape: {train_split.shape}")
print(f"Validation split shape: {val_split.shape}")

# Build prediction model using frequency-based approach
# KEY FIX: Map based on 'before' only, as 'class' is not available in test set.
# Using 'class' in validation prediction inflated the previous score.
print("Building prediction model...")

# Efficiently find the most common 'after' for each 'before' token
# groupby 'before', then value_counts on 'after', then pick the top one for each 'before'
counts = train_split.groupby("before")["after"].value_counts()
# idxmax returns the index of the max value (which is (before, after) tuple) for each group
best = counts.groupby(level=0).idxmax()
# Convert to dictionary: {before: after}
before_to_after = {before: after for before, after in best.values}

# Predict on validation set (Simulating test conditions: no class info)
print("Predicting on validation set...")
# Use map for vectorized prediction, fillna with original token if not found
val_predictions = val_split["before"].map(before_to_after).fillna(val_split["before"])

# Calculate validation accuracy
val_accuracy = (val_predictions == val_split["after"]).mean()
print(f"Validation Accuracy (Hold-out, no class info): {val_accuracy:.6f}")

# Predict on test set
print("Predicting on test set...")
test_predictions = test_df["before"].map(before_to_after).fillna(test_df["before"])

# Create submission dataframe
submission_df = pd.DataFrame(
    {
        "id": test_df["sentence_id"].astype(str)
        + "_"
        + test_df["token_id"].astype(str),
        "after": test_predictions,
    }
)

# Ensure submission format matches sample
submission_df["id"] = submission_df["id"].astype(str)
submission_df["after"] = submission_df["after"].astype(str)

# Check if submission matches sample submission format
sample_ids = set(sample_submission["id"])
submission_ids = set(submission_df["id"])
print(f"Submission IDs match sample: {sample_ids == submission_ids}")

# Save submission
os.makedirs("./submission", exist_ok=True)
submission_df.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)
print("Submission saved to ./submission/submission.csv")

# Final accuracy print
print(f"Final Validation Accuracy: {val_accuracy:.6f}")
